s00_cover_kpis.caption: Cover sheet: author block and the two KPI tile rows, every number computed by an Excel formula or exported from the program.
s00_cover_kpis.concept: Documentation generated from the program's own output

sheet_vertex_cube.caption: Cube vertex buffer: 24 unique vertices (4 per face) as interleaved x, y, z, nx, ny, nz; the face is derived from the normal by an Excel formula. (The lab primitives carry no texture coordinates.)
sheet_vertex_cube.concept: Vertex attributes, per-face normals, interleaved layout (Lab 04)

s02_cube_indices.caption: Cube index buffer: 12 triangles = 36 indices; column O is an Excel formula testing the winding with n0 . ((p1-p0) x (p2-p0)) (green = CCW = front face).
s02_cube_indices.concept: Indexed drawing and counter-clockwise winding / back-face culling

sheet_memory.caption: Technique 1 (separate triangles) versus Technique 2 (unique vertices + indices) for one face and for the whole cube; every figure is an Excel formula and the last row checks it against the exporter's byte count.
sheet_memory.concept: Vertex buffer memory: non-indexed vs indexed (VBO + EBO)

s02_sphere_cylinder.caption: Sphere and cylinder vertex data (first 12 vertices each); the check columns |p| = 0.5 and sqrt(x^2+y^2) = 0.5 confirm the parametrisation.
s02_sphere_cylinder.concept: Procedural primitives: spherical / cylindrical parametrisation and analytic normals

s03_primitive_mix.caption: Primitive mix per final object: how many cylinders, spheres, cones, cubes and frusta (and how many group nodes) build each object; Excel COUNTIFS over the 4 549-row construction table.
s03_primitive_mix.concept: Everything is built from five unit primitives

s03_bunker.caption: Construction rows of the command bunker (21 rows of 417 shown; row labels are the real sheet rows). Every part is one primitive with S, R (degrees) and T relative to its parent; shading model in the last column. Command bunker (underground, 400 parts): walls, ramp, blast doors and rooms as cubes and cylinders.
s03_bunker.concept: Primitive composition with S, R, T rows

s03_uav.caption: Construction rows of the autonomous uav (22 rows of 96 shown; row labels are the real sheet rows). Every part is one primitive with S, R (degrees) and T relative to its parent; shading model in the last column. Autonomous UAV: fuselage, four motor mounts with rotor groups, gimbal yaw / pitch chain, searchlight.

s03_rover.caption: Construction rows of the target rover (13 rows of 28 shown; row labels are the real sheet rows). Every part is one primitive with S, R (degrees) and T relative to its parent; shading model in the last column. Target rover: chassis, wheels, thermal engine block (heat column drives the thermal camera).
s03_rover.concept: Instancing of a primitive per part

sheet_construction_tank.caption: Construction rows of the main battle tank (14 rows of 284 shown; row labels are the real sheet rows). Every part is one primitive with S, R (degrees) and T relative to its parent; shading model in the last column. Main battle tank: hull, tracks, turret yaw, gun pitch and recoil group.

s03_helicopter.caption: Construction rows of the scout helicopter (19 rows of 110 shown; row labels are the real sheet rows). Every part is one primitive with S, R (degrees) and T relative to its parent; shading model in the last column. Scout helicopter: fuselage, main rotor and tail rotor groups.

s03_aagun.caption: Construction rows of the aa gatling gun (17 rows of 83 shown; row labels are the real sheet rows). Every part is one primitive with S, R (degrees) and T relative to its parent; shading model in the last column. AA Gatling gun: pedestal, yaw / pitch mount, rotating barrel cluster.

s03_radar.caption: Construction rows of the air-defence radar (16 rows of 112 shown; row labels are the real sheet rows). Every part is one primitive with S, R (degrees) and T relative to its parent; shading model in the last column. Air-defence radar: tower and rotating antenna of tiles.

s03_sam.caption: Construction rows of the sam launcher (20 rows of 121 shown; row labels are the real sheet rows). Every part is one primitive with S, R (degrees) and T relative to its parent; shading model in the last column. SAM launcher: chassis, elevating launcher frame and missile tubes.

s03_mlrs.caption: Construction rows of the mlrs rocket truck (21 rows of 158 shown; row labels are the real sheet rows). Every part is one primitive with S, R (degrees) and T relative to its parent; shading model in the last column. MLRS rocket truck: cab, elevating pod frame and rocket tubes.

s03_gate.caption: Construction rows of the boom barrier (12 rows of 22 shown; row labels are the real sheet rows). Every part is one primitive with S, R (degrees) and T relative to its parent; shading model in the last column. Gate boom barrier: post, counterweight and pivoting boom with stripes.

s03_flag.caption: Construction rows of the flag (16 rows of 61 shown; row labels are the real sheet rows). Every part is one primitive with S, R (degrees) and T relative to its parent; shading model in the last column. Flag: pole and a chain of cloth strips each yawed by a travelling wave.

s03_tank_material.caption: Tank rows, material and thermal columns: shading, procedural surface, roughness, metalness, heat (thermal-camera value), emissive, animation text.
s03_tank_material.concept: Per-part material (PBR) and heat for the thermal camera

sheet_mmult.caption: Worked example for one component (CAMP-55): rotation blocks Ry, Rx, Rz, then R = Ry x Rx x Rz, T x R and finally M = T x R x S, every cell an Excel sum of products; the last block is |M - M_code|.
sheet_mmult.concept: Model matrix M = T . R . S built by matrix products

s04_inputs_blocks.caption: Worked example inputs (S, R in degrees, T looked up by component ID with INDEX / MATCH) and the translation, yaw, pitch blocks, plus Ry x Rx.
s04_inputs_blocks.concept: Homogeneous 4x4 matrices: translation and axis rotations

s04_rows_error.caption: Per-component rows of sheet 4 for the UAV gimbal chain: S, R, T inputs, the 3x3 rotation entries and the max-error column (Excel M versus the code's matrix).
s04_rows_error.concept: Excel recomputes the matrices the program uses (verification, tolerance 1e-4)

s04_rows_m.caption: The 12 M entries computed by Excel for the gimbal chain next to the code's matrix, and the max |difference| column.
s04_rows_m.concept: Model matrix entries M11..M34 (Excel) vs code

sheet_hierarchy.caption: Hierarchy sheet, UAV gimbal chain: UAV root > gimbal yaw > gimbal pitch > lamp / lens / camera; world position and the Excel-vs-code check, with the animation text of each joint.
sheet_hierarchy.concept: Scene graph: world = parent_world x M down a chain

s05_tank_chain.caption: Hierarchy sheet, tank chain: tank root > hull > turret yaw > gun pitch > mantlet / barrel recoil. Depth increases by one per joint.
s05_tank_chain.concept: Articulated chain: turret yaw then gun pitch then recoil

s05_world_matrix.caption: World matrices of the UAV gimbal chain computed by Excel: W = W_parent x M (each W cell is a sum of products referencing the parent's row and sheet 4), next to the code's values.
s05_world_matrix.concept: World matrix = parent world matrix x local matrix

s06_geometry_stats.caption: Memory of every GPU mesh: indexed versus non-indexed, per-mesh saving and vertex reuse, and the formula vs exporter check.

s06_charts.caption: Memory charts: bytes per mesh indexed versus non-indexed (drawn from the sheet's chart definitions).

sheet_lighting.caption: The three scene lights plus the ambient term: type, position, direction, colour, intensity, attenuation coefficients (k linear, k quadratic), spot cone angles, role.
sheet_lighting.concept: Light types (directional / point / spot), attenuation and cone parameters

s07_attenuation.caption: Distance attenuation 1/(1 + k1 d + k2 d^2) for the beacon and the searchlight, and the spotlight cone factor versus angle; all Excel formulas.
s07_attenuation.concept: Attenuation law and spot cone falloff

s07_charts.caption: Attenuation and cone curves drawn from the sheet's scatter charts.

s08_shading.caption: Shading models used in the scene: parts using each (COUNTIF), which normal is used, where lighting is evaluated, cost and visual effect.
s08_shading.concept: Flat vs Gouraud vs Phong vs PBR

s08_comparison.caption: Same bunker, same camera: flat, Gouraud and Phong override side by side (renders from the program).

s09_pipeline_passes.caption: GPU pass list of one frame (measured): time per pass, share of the total and cumulative time, Excel formulas.
s09_pipeline_passes.concept: Render pipeline: shadow maps, pre-pass, SSAO, volumetric fog, scene, bloom, composite

s09_features.caption: Per-feature frame cost: configuration, frame time, baseline, feature cost and share (differences computed by Excel).

s10_testing.caption: Test sheet: KPI row (tests, passed, failed, pass rate - Excel formulas over the status column) and the first 25 tests with expected and observed results.
s10_testing.concept: Automated verification of the geometry, transforms and lighting

sheet_controllables.caption: All controllable objects: root, part counts per primitive, group nodes and animated nodes (Excel SUMIFS over the construction sheet).

s14_uav.caption: Controllable UAV-1 DRONE: the moving parts and the animation rule of each articulated node, as exported from the code.
s14_uav.concept: Joint hierarchy and procedural animation per object

s14_aagun.concept: Joint hierarchy and procedural animation per object

s14_radar.caption: Controllable AIR-DEFENCE RADAR: the moving parts and the animation rule of each articulated node, as exported from the code.
s14_radar.concept: Joint hierarchy and procedural animation per object

s14_doors.caption: Controllable BLAST DOORS: the moving parts and the animation rule of each articulated node, as exported from the code.
s14_doors.concept: Joint hierarchy and procedural animation per object

s14_sam.caption: Controllable SAM-1 LAUNCHER: the moving parts and the animation rule of each articulated node, as exported from the code.
s14_sam.concept: Joint hierarchy and procedural animation per object

s14_mlrs.caption: Controllable MLRS-1 ROCKET TRUCK: the moving parts and the animation rule of each articulated node, as exported from the code.
s14_mlrs.concept: Joint hierarchy and procedural animation per object

s14_gate.caption: Controllable GATE BARRIER: the moving parts and the animation rule of each articulated node, as exported from the code.
s14_gate.concept: Joint hierarchy and procedural animation per object

s14_specs_tank.caption: Specification rows of the tank read from the code constants, with the Excel-derived figures in sheet 14 below them.
s14_specs_tank.concept: Kinematic limits (slew rates, elevation range, reload)

s14_derived.caption: Derived figures computed by Excel from the specification table (e.g. turret 360 degrees = 360 / slew rate).

s16_weapons.caption: Weapons: speeds, blast power, damage radius (= power x kDamageRadiusPerPower), flight time, range, reload and guidance; formulas over the constants table.

s16_effects.caption: Particle effects measured by running the real Combat code: particle count, peak, lifetime and dynamic light for each effect.
s16_effects.concept: Particle systems and dynamic lights for explosions

sheet_cv.caption: Computer-vision pipeline: the 11 stages from the adaptive threshold to the Kalman track life cycle, with the code location of each.
sheet_cv.concept: Image processing on the thermal view: threshold, labelling, tracking

s18_params_footprint.caption: Derived camera figures (pixels per degree, horizontal FOV, gate radius) and the ground footprint of one pixel versus UAV altitude, all Excel formulas.
s18_params_footprint.concept: Camera model: field of view, pixel-to-ground scale

s18_tests.caption: Vision tests T130-T137 with their PASS status looked up from the testing sheet (INDEX / MATCH).

sheet_mission.caption: Time-on-target model of the rail rounds: ramp distance, flight time t(d) and its closed-form check against roundFlightTime(d); the last row confirms formula = code.
sheet_mission.concept: Kinematics of a homing round with acceleration ramp

s19_combined.caption: Combined strike: launch delay of the nearer UAV so both rounds arrive together (arrival spread = 0).

s19_waves.caption: Mission constants: waves, base integrity and score parameters from the code.

s19_armour.caption: Armour and damage falloff: damage per round, rounds to kill with one or two UAVs and the reload of one UAV, Excel formulas.

s20_sounds.caption: Synthesised sounds: trigger, technique and key parameters of all 15 sounds (no sample files).

s20_mixer.caption: Mixer: sample rate, voices, panning, distance gain, air absorption, Doppler.

s20_hud_tests.caption: Audio tests with PASS status looked up from sheet 10.

sheet_daycycle.caption: Day Cycle & Lighting: the exported 24 h grid (sun elevation, key intensity, ambient, fog, exposure, solar, beams, waves, cloud-shadow mean) with the Excel recomputation of the sun elevation from latitude, declination and hour, the difference and the OK check.
sheet_daycycle.concept: Solar position model and the day-cycle lighting curves

sheet_soldiers.caption: Soldiers & Routes: roster with day / night duty, primitive counts per soldier (Excel totals), route lengths, joint tree and gait constants.
sheet_soldiers.concept: Soldier hierarchy, gait and spline routes

sheet_cvnoise.caption: CV Noise & Seeds: sensor noise configuration, P_d / false-alarm sweep against NETD, derived stream seeds and the v6 tests with the status looked up from the testing sheet.
sheet_cvnoise.concept: Sensor noise model and detector statistics

sheet_raytracing.caption: Ray Tracing: the five render modes cycled with ';' (names and captions from the code), their internal resolution, the measured GPU frame and ray-tracing pass times on the RTX 4070 for the selected run, FPS, speed-up versus raster and ns per traced pixel (Excel formulas over the raytrace_perf.json rows below), and the KPI strip.
sheet_raytracing.concept: Ray tracing modes and their cost: raster, hybrid, Whitted, path, light tracing

sheet_rt_bvh.caption: Ray Tracing, BVH: the surface-area-heuristic cost of the root split recomputed by Excel from the exported child boxes, and a 64 x 36 probe of primary rays: BVH node visits and primitive tests per ray versus brute force, with the hit-for-hit agreement check.
sheet_rt_bvh.concept: Bounding volume hierarchy and the SAH cost model

sheet_explorer.caption: Frame Explorer: the 16 stages of one frame as the program shows them (fx::stageInfo: title, caption, key formula, concepts), the layers of each stage and its capture in report/figures_v7.
sheet_explorer.concept: Frame generation step by step: the stages of the graphics pipeline

sheet_controls.caption: Game Camera & Controls: the v7 key bindings exported from keyBindingsV7 (the rows the F1 help draws) with the owning work package, and the keys inside the Frame Explorer.
sheet_controls.concept: Game camera controls: POV picker, jumps, free camera, render modes, ray debugger, explorer

sheet_pov_sources.caption: Game Camera & Controls, POV sources: every moving object the camera can jump into (listPovSources at t = 0), whether the player can take control, the alternative view, position, distance, the picker row recomputed by Excel (nearest first) and the first-person eye.

sheet_v7tests.caption: v7 Tests: the v7 test blocks (T240-T310) with PASS / FAIL / pending counted by COUNTIFS over the test list, whose status is looked up from the testing sheet.
